technical.summary: LMT shows structural bullish alignment (price above all major MAs, supertrend, hull flip) but lacks momentum confirmation (MACD bearish, ADX weak, volume subdued), making this a moderate-quality setup suitable for patient entry on pullback rather than aggressive chase.

fundamental.summary: LMT shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contract wins, and no lobbying activity; earnings in 26 days present timing risk with minimal fundamental support.

sentiment.congressional_conviction: medium — moderate amounts, junior-to-mid tier members
sentiment.summary: Moderate congressional buying (2+ months stale) combined with market fear (35 VIX-like score) and bearish AAII sentiment (47.6%) creates a contrarian buy setup, though lack of recent news data and aged trades limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (226) indicates extreme market stress, and earnings in 26 days adds event risk; only DXY tailwind provides minor offset.

debate.key_bull_argument: Structural bullish alignment (price above 200-EMA, supertrend bullish, hull flip up) combined with contrarian congressional buying and fear-zone sentiment creates a contrarian entry opportunity for patient traders.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels at 226, earnings risk in 26 days), absent momentum confirmation (MACD bearish, ADX weak, RSI not rising), and subdued volume make this a high-risk setup with unfavorable risk/reward in a recessionary environment.

decision.entry_rationale: Structural bullish alignment (price above 200-EMA, supertrend, hull flip) offers contrarian appeal in fear-zone sentiment, but momentum divergence (MACD bearish, ADX weak, RSI flat) and subdued volume require confirmation before entry.
decision.primary_risk: Inverted yield curve combined with VIX crisis levels (226) and earnings event in 26 days create severe macro headwinds that could trigger sharp reversal despite technical setup.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical and sentiment agents show bullish lean, but fundamental and risk agents strongly bearish; debate winner is bear with medium confidence.
